plan.title: release-e2e: do not attempt temp-repo delete during agent release; report for manual cleanup

narratives.Description: Default release-e2e to keep+report temp repos instead of attempting gh repo delete. Agents lack delete_repo permission; failed deletes stall releases. Optional --destroy-repo for privileged environments.
narratives.Overview:
## Problem

Phase 3 (`task release:e2e`) provisions a throwaway repo but agents typically lack `delete_repo` permission (#1019). The harness still attempts destroy in try/finally, producing noisy failures.

## Desired behavior

1. Default: no `gh repo delete`; report owner/slug + cleanup command.
2. Optional `--destroy-repo` for CI/operator with delete rights.
3. Skipped/failed delete must not block Phase 4 when rehearsal succeeded.
4. Summary always includes full owner/slug and copy-paste cleanup hint.
narratives.UserStory: As a release agent without delete_repo permission, I want release:e2e to keep the temp repo and report cleanup, so Phase 3 does not stall the release flow.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Invert default in packages/core/src/release-e2e: replace --keep-repo with --destroy-repo (opt-in delete).
2. Update finally-block emits to always surface owner/slug + manual cleanup hint.
3. Update content/skills/deft-directive-release/SKILL.md Phase 3 prose.
4. Update tests and CHANGELOG [Unreleased].
narratives.Acceptance:
1. No default delete
2. Summary cleanup hint with owner/slug
3. Skill docs updated
4. Tests pass
5. CHANGELOG entry

narrative.Acceptance: Given default flags, when rehearsal completes, then destroyTempRepo is not called and stderr includes owner/slug plus gh repo delete cleanup hint.
Given --destroy-repo, when rehearsal completes, then destroyTempRepo runs; failure emits WARN but does not change rehearsal exit code.
Given deft-directive-release SKILL.md Phase 3, when an agent reads it, then it documents keep+report default, no retry of deletion, and summary cleanup requirement.

expected_outputs: Default path skips gh repo delete
